**What version of ESLint are you using?**
2.5.1
**What parser (default, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?**
default
**Please show your full configuration:**
None.
**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**
`eslint --init` and select the default options. When the question about indentation style appears, there is no default option selected. Press Enter.
**What did you expect to happen?**
To get to the next question and, eventually, a configuration file.
**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**
An exception is thrown.

```
Spaces Cannot read property 'short' of undefined
TypeError: Cannot read property 'short' of undefined
    at Prompt.render (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/lib/prompts/list.js:94:69)
    at Prompt.onSubmit (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/lib/prompts/list.js:116:8)
    at AnonymousObserver.Rx.AnonymousObserver.AnonymousObserver.next (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/node_modules/rx-lite/rx.lite.js:1535:12)
    at AnonymousObserver.Rx.internals.AbstractObserver.AbstractObserver.onNext (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/node_modules/rx-lite/rx.lite.js:1469:31)

    at AutoDetachObserver.Rx.internals.AbstractObserver.AbstractObserver.onNext (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/node_modules/rx-lite/rx.lite.js:1469:31)
    at AnonymousObserver._onNext (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/node_modules/rx-lite/rx.lite.js:4234:13)
    at AnonymousObserver.Rx.AnonymousObserver.AnonymousObserver.next (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/eslint/node_modules/inquirer/node_modules/rx-lite/rx.lite.js:1535:12)

```

The problem is the default option is wrong. I'll submit a PR.
